entity.name: Kartik Hulmukh
entity.description: Solo founder and maintainer of Kairo-Phantom, based in India. I build open-source, privacy-preserving desktop AI tooling whose behaviour can be independently verified rather than trusted. Kairo-Phantom is MIT-licensed and developed in the open.

projects.name: Kairo-Phantom
projects.description: An offline-first, on-device AI desktop agent that produces a signed, independently-verifiable audit trail of what it does. A sealed runtime mode is designed to block and detect outbound network connections across declared/tested interfaces during a session (air-gap oracle + kill-proof in CI; not a claim of absolute network isolation on every OS/interface). Default text embeddings load from vendored local model weights; optional CLIP media embeddings need a one-time local model download or KAIRO_CLIP_MODEL_PATH and are refused under sealed/offline flags. Every action is appended to an Ed25519 hash-chained log that anyone can verify offline with the bundled external verifier — tampering with any entry breaks the chain. It includes a prompt-injection screen and a PII guard on inputs, and twelve preserved domain adapters (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, Legal, Design, Code, Voice, Media, Memory, Export, Security) with fixture/readback suites under active maintenance (core sidecar fixture suites pass in CI; some optional design/export engine paths need local engines). Driving live desktop applications end-to-end is an experimental capability under active hardening. Built for people and organisations that need a local AI assistant whose actions leave a tamper-evident, offline-checkable record.
